title: Guild Assignments
description: A Magister's seat comes with a standing bill. The Circle keeps a running list of what it needs - reagents, recovered artifacts, phenomena somebody has to go and look at - and expects its own to work it down instead of drawing a stipend for nothing. Take the next assignment off Elara's list and clear it.

objectives.description: Take the next assignment off the Circle's standing list
objectives.notes: Random assignment generated based on current world state

objectives.description: Do whatever the assignment turns out to need
objectives.notes: Could be: collect reagents, kill magical creatures, explore ruins, deliver items

objectives.description: Report back to Elara that the list is one shorter

notes: UNCOMPLETABLE: the `complete_task` objective uses type `variable`, which QuestManager deliberately does not implement - there is no handler for it anywhere in the engine, so this quest can be accepted but never finished. Already on the wave_b dispositions list. Prose rewritten for tone only; the underlying structural defect is untouched and out of scope for a prose-only pass - fixing it means either replacing `variable` with a real objective type or building the handler, both data/engine changes this batch's hard limits forbid. Repeatable quest, Magister rank.
